sites.name: Broemmelsiek Astronomy Viewing Area
sites.access: Dedicated astronomy area open around the clock; the rest of the park has separate hours. Friday public telescope sessions are weather-dependent.

sites.name: Stacy Park stargazing field
sites.access: Open field only, dusk to dawn, year-round. Bring a star app or other astronomy aid; use red lights. Quiet hours 10 PM–7 AM. No sleeping.
sites.coordinatePrecision: Park center; use the designated open field.

sites.name: McDonnell Planetarium telescope nights
sites.access: Nighttime telescope viewing is offered on scheduled Star Party dates. Check the official calendar; no walk-in nighttime session is implied.

sites.name: Babler State Park astronomy programs
sites.access: Use a scheduled astronomy program or confirmed camping permission for nighttime access. Day-use admission does not authorize staying after closing.
sites.coordinatePrecision: Park reference point; follow program directions.
